title: A Quantum Machine Learning Approach to Content-Based Media Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21562v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We use quantum machine learning techniques to develop a content-based media recommender system and evaluate its performance on TV programmes using textual descriptions from one week of BBC iPlayer data. Grounded in the Quantum Natural Language Processing framework (QNLP), programme synopses are mapped to variational quantum circuits using their semantic structure. The parameters of these circuits are trained via a supervised pairwise similarity learning task.   We benchmark the quantum recommender against a classical BiLSTM baseline trained on the same dataset and objective. While both models achieve comparable performance on the similarity learning task, the quantum model requires significantly fewer parameters (47k vs. 17.8M). translated_title: 一种用于基于内容媒体推荐的量子机器学习方法
translated_abstract: 我们使用量子机器学习技术开发了一个基于内容的媒体推荐系统，并利用BBC iPlayer一周数据中的文本描述，在电视节目上评估了其性能。该方法基于量子自然语言处理（QNLP）框架，将节目简介根据其语义结构映射为变分量子电路，并通过监督式成对相似性学习任务来训练这些电路的参数。我们将该量子推荐系统与在同一数据集和相同目标上训练的经典BiLSTM基线模型进行了基准对比。虽然两个模型在相似性学习任务上取得了相当的性能，但量子模型所需的参数量显著更少（4.7万 vs. 1780万）。当BiLSTM被限制在与量子模型相同的参数预算时，其性能大幅下降（平均精度均值MAP下降3.63个百分点），这表明结构化量子表示……
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于量子自然语言处理框架的媒体推荐系统，其以仅为经典BiLSTM基线约0.3%的参数量（4.7万 vs 1780万）达到了相当的推荐性能，而经典模型在同等参数预算下性能显著下降，展示了结构化量子表示在参数效率上的优势。
en_tdlr: A quantum machine learning recommender system grounded in QNLP achieves performance comparable to a classical BiLSTM baseline with drastically fewer parameters (47k vs. 17.8M), while the classical model degrades substantially under a matching parameter budget, demonstrating the parameter efficiency of structured quantum representations.
